occurrences.englishText: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Behold, I will punish Amon of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with her gods, and her kings; even Pharaoh, and those who trust in him.
I will pour my wrath on Sin,
I will set a fire in Egypt
Are you better than No-Amon,* or, Thebes who was situated among the rivers, who had the waters around her; whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was of the sea?
